issuer: the transport administration authority (közlekedési igazgatási hatóság), at a government window (kormányablak)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on net.jogtar.hu (Wolters Kluwer's free collection of the laws in force). The Government Decree on road transport administration (326/2011. (XII. 28.) Korm. rendelet) gives category B from 17, and a licence for categories like B valid until the date of fitness the medical examination sets, at most ten years from issue (§ 29); 10 years is held, a shorter medical term not being modelled. The ministerial decree on the fees of road transport administration procedures (47/2024. (XII. 30.) ÉKM rendelet, in force from 1 February 2025) gives the procedure for issuing a driving licence at 6,900 Ft, held (3,000 Ft for someone past the pension age, not held). The novice period, the exams and the driving school aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's.
